title: GTA6 Original Soundtrack Revealed with 34 Songs and Streaming Tracks
description: GTA6's original soundtrack has been partially revealed, featuring 34 original tracks from multiple real-world artists, with six tracks available to stream today.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Original Soundtrack Revealed: 34 Tracks and Six Songs Streaming Now

The highly anticipated open-world crime game Grand Theft Auto 6 has received a fresh update regarding its in-game audio experience. According to a report by Eurogamer, details about the original soundtrack for GTA6 have partially emerged, giving players a first glimpse at the musical landscape of the upcoming title.

A Massive Musical Lineup

Music has always been a core pillar of the Grand Theft Auto franchise, setting the mood for everything from high-speed police chases to casual drives down the highway. Based on the latest information, the full album for GTA6 will feature a total of **34 original tracks** crafted specifically for the upcoming open-world crime game.

Furthermore, the soundtrack incorporates music from **multiple real-world artists**, blending commercial music talent with the game's immersive, criminal underworld. This approach aligns with Rockstar Games' long-standing tradition of curating iconic soundtracks that define the cultural zeitgeist of their release eras.

Stream Six Tracks Today

To build excitement, the reveal didn't just stop at a tracklist count. Fans eager to experience the game's audio direction do not have to wait for the full release; **six tracks are available to stream today**. This gives the community an immediate taste of what to expect when diving into the game's vibrant and dangerous setting.

While details beyond the initial soundtrack reveal remain sparse, the confirmation of 34 original songs highlights the immense scale and production value being poured into GTA6. As more tracks and details surface, the anticipation for how these songs will integrate into the open-world gameplay continues to grow.

Editor's Take

Music is the beating heart of the Grand Theft Auto series. Revealing 34 original tracks alongside six streamable songs is a brilliant way to keep community momentum high. It proves that Rockstar is once again investing heavily in the auditory identity of the game, ensuring the new world feels as alive through the ears as it does through the eyes.
